Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Non-Invasive Blood Pressure (NIBP) system with data acqui sition and accessories The system should have the following specification and parameters A. Non-Invasive Blood pressure monitoring device · The system should use the latest volume pressure Recording by periodic occlusion of blood flow in th e tail to measure Systolic, Diastolic, Mean blood Pressure and Heart Rate. · The sensor should be able to record the diastolic BP, tail blood flow and volume directly from the tail f or accuracy and reliability. · The system should well validated, accepted and supported with white papers and citations. · Should be able to record the data easily from dark skinned rodents also. · Should have warming pad with homeothermic controller. · Should include rectal probe for monitoring the core temperature. · Should work on Mice and Rat with wide range of body weights. · Should be supplied with clear acrylic holders to allow complete visibility and unrestricted breathing · Should be supplied with advance data acquisition system with built in bio-amplifier for recording ECG, EMG, EEG with electronic Isolated stimulator. · The system should allow measuring pulse oximetry from small animals with a help of advance SpO2 Animal Clip. The spO2 clip should be lightweight, ultra-sensitive clip-on sensor for use on the rear foot, front foot and tail of small animals. · The laser diode-based pulse oximetry signal provides a direct analog output of the partial oxygen pres sure in blood in animals and data can be recorded and analysed along with the other cardiovascular p arameters. B. Computerised Recording and Analysis Software

· Software with step by step instructions, protocol and experimental design for performing various exp eriments in Pharmacology research and teaching applications. · Should have sample data for animal experiments for demonstration. · User friendly software for recording, analysing and printing the data, the software should allow calibra tion of transducers, display of actual values, controllable gain, filter settings, baseline, settings for eve nt marking and annotation. · Software should be capable of measuring time interval between user selected points, display of data value at user selected point, editing of the records and re-annotation. · It should be capable of displaying data in scope mode and chart mode. It should allow calculation of r ate, period, frequency, min, max, count, integral, derivative, height etc. from raw channels in offline as well as online mode. · Software should allow the export of raw data in.txt, mat, .wav, abf, pxp, binary and edf, formats. · Software should allow linking / transporting of data to MS Excel and also support live streaming. · Software should have automatic analysis features for ECG, HRV (time and frequency domain) and also should have provision for future upgrades. C. Consumable and Accessories to be supplied · Sufficient number of Rodent retainers (At least three) should be supplied for rats weighing from 75g- 400g body weight. · Mice holder/restrainer should be supplied for up to 25g body weight · Extra set of replacement bladders for both rat and mice should be included. · Needle Electrodes for ECG should be provided. D. Data Analysis Workstation Type: Desktop (Windows 10/11 Pro 64-bit or mac OS). Specs: Minimum Cor e i7 (or higher), 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD and 1 TB hard disk. Display: Minimum 24-inch Monitor (for viewi ng multiple signal channels clearly). Should have sufficient number of high speed USB 2.0 interface for c omputer. The brand/make may be specified in the bid. At least 1 KVA UPS with 30 minutes back up sho uld be provided. E. Installation, Training, Documentation and Support · ISO and IEC/CE/BIS Certification and any other essential certification to be provided. · Delivery and Installation should be done free of charge. · On-site training of at-least two days should be provided during the installation. · Comprehensive Warranty 36 months on the complete system (including sensors). · In addition to physical preventive maintenance, company should be able to provide telephonic/online support if required. · Demonstration of the quoted instrument prior to technical specification approval must be arranged by the Vendor in physical mode at their own cost. . 14.
